description: Call once at the start of a non-trivial task to check the user's saved prompts. Returns up to `limit` prompts from their own library that match the task (title/description match, weighted by past use). If one fits, fetch it with get_prompt (via: 'suggestion'). An empty list means nothing fits — carry on normally. The task text is not stored.

task.description: A short description of the user's task

name: suggest_prompts
title: Suggest saved prompts
